_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX add-recipient-personal screen (953:7721). Reuses the cross-screen baseline: 1px geometry, 0.5px font, deltaE 2, same font aliases (HarmonyOS Sans TC → SC + Plus Jakarta Sans for Latin glyphs), and the cross-screen iconDeviations (status-bar accessory, chevron, bottom-nav glyphs, back-arrow). Add-recipient-personal-specific: the 个人 chip carries a User Circle filled glyph (cf. 企业 sibling's Building 4) — both are 24×24 inline SVG approximations.
_fontAliasNote: Figma masters label CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships the SC variant + Plus Jakarta Sans Latin glyphs. Same Huawei family.
_ignoreTextNote: iOS status-bar mock — the only data-driven text in this screen is empty placeholders (forms have no balance / fee numerics).

deviations.reason: Inner SVG vector subnodes inside iconography (status-bar accessory, back-arrow, chevron-down, chip glyphs, bottom-nav glyphs). Each parent icon name is in iconDeviations (path-set waiver); these missing inner Vector subnodes are the same physical reason — the impl renders the icon as a single inline SVG path, not the figma-authored multi-vector composition. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Accessory
iconDeviations.reason: iOS status-bar accessory frame (signal / wifi / battery) — rendered as approximation SVGs in the harness. Pure phone-chrome iconography, not part of the SPX product. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: icon
iconDeviations.reason: Back-arrow icon frame on the page header. Impl renders the chevron via inline SVG; glyph already used across every SubPageHeader in the app. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Arrows / Alt Arrow Down
iconDeviations.reason: Single-stroke chevron-down glyph (used by the country picker placeholder). Impl renders the same chevron via inline SVG path. Glyph parity has been waived for chevrons cross-screen; same waiver applies here. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Users / User Circle
iconDeviations.reason: 个人 (personal) chip glyph in the active 账户类型 card, AND bottom-nav 我的 (inactive) icon. Impl renders an approximated user-in-circle outline via inline SVG; full glyph parity deferred — same waiver as account-info screen. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Buildings / Buildings 4
iconDeviations.reason: 企业 (business) chip glyph in the inactive 账户类型 card. Impl renders an approximated building outline. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Money / Wallet
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 账户 (active) icon. Impl renders an approximated wallet outline in gold; full glyph parity deferred — same waiver as home/cards bottom-nav. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Money / Card
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 消费 (inactive) icon. Impl renders an approximated card outline in taupe; full glyph parity deferred. Approved 2026-05-29.

iconDeviations.name: Linear / Essentional, UI / Home Angle
